subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a permanent persisted cron status and public Gateway, hook, CLI, UI, and Plugin SDK contract for yielded parents?
rationale: The runtime bug is concrete, but exposing a fourth durable status across public and persisted surfaces is a compatibility and product-model choice that source correctness and live proof cannot decide.

options.title: Approve the public deferred state
options.body: Keep the shared classifier and public `deferred` status, then require exact-head upgrade and end-to-end delivery proof before merge.

options.title: Keep waiting state internal
options.body: Represent yielded waiting internally while preserving the existing public cron status contract until the parent reaches a final outcome.

options.title: Split the contract expansion
options.body: Land the internal lifecycle repair separately and review the public status, SDK, UI, and persistence expansion in a narrower follow-up.

recommendation.title: Approve the public deferred state
recommendation.body: Keep the shared classifier and public `deferred` status, then require exact-head upgrade and end-to-end delivery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline routed this account into the cross-cutting agent and cron lifecycle review, making it the best available decision-routing candidate.
